facts: The W3C specification identifies WebSub as the successor name of PubSubHubbub and references versions0.3 and0.4.
A topic is an HTTP(S) resource; section4 discovery explicitly requires subscribers to issue GET or HEAD to retrieve its URL and inspect HTTP Link headers before embedded links.
The subscriber callback must be network-accessible for actual notifications; subscription itself uses a separate hub POST.
Protocol discovery is not an unrestricted polling, permanent storage or cross-owner aggregation license.
